version: 0.4.0
kind: capability-udi
schema_type: capability

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.capability-udi
  name: capability-udi.schema
  description: Canonical schema defining UDI rules for capabilities.

spec:
  target_kind: capability-udi
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: pattern
    path: pattern
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: maxSegments
    path: maxSegments
    type: integer
    required: true

  - name: allowSlugSeparator
    path: allowSlugSeparator
    type: string
    required: true

object:
  pattern: "^prismata\\.meta\\.capability\\.[a-z0-9-|]+$"
  maxSegments: 4
  allowSlugSeparator: "|"
